text:
lee: Quick FYI — EU canary showing increased 5xx rates + autoscaler churn. I'm freezing promotions for release 1.42.1 (EU) until we validate.

deploybot: PROMOTION_FREEZE applied: release=1.42.1 scope=eu-promote by=lee reason=ingress-5xx-spike :warning:

tara: copy. does freeze block windowed re-runs or just traffic promos?

lee: only blocking traffic promotion (canary -> region). builds and image pushes still go through. No fleet-wide ops yet.

devin: svc-owner here. recommend soft rollback of canary to 1.42.0 to reduce noise while SRE investigates. If metrics recover, we can re-run a controlled canary with throttled ramp.

hao: SRE: we see LB queueing + pod churn at ~13:05 UTC. Soft rollback will help isolate infra vs code. If after rollback p99 remains high -> escalate to full rollback.

deploybot: Soft rollback command:
```
deploy rollback --release 1.42.1 --to 1.42.0 --scope canary --note "eu ingress 5xx"
```

lee: executing soft rollback now. will update when traffic flips. planning a 20m observation window then decide on reschedule.

ops-bot: Noted — pausing EU scheduled jobs for 25m to reduce noisy signals.

lee: rollback executed, canary reverted to 1.42.0. initial dashboards show 5xx down, p99 improving. Holding promotions until the 20m stability window completes.

tara: i'll update the release doc and mark the GA window tentative. also adding a short note for release-comms in case we push EU GA.

devin: if stability holds, plan: retry canary with --ramp 10%/5m and extra debug logging, then resume promotions. If instability returns, we'll discuss full rollback and slip EU GA window by one business day.

hao: continuing infra checks, will post RCA draft if LB config or autoscaler thresholds are implicated.

lee: thanks everyone. will reconvene at +20m or sooner if ops-bot flags a regression. :thumbsup:
